generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Corrigendum / modifications / correction, if any, will be published in the KPP portal only

Tenderers are required to read the Bid Documents carefully before submission of their bid. Any discrepancies observed in the documents uploaded by the tenderer the tender shall liable to rejected. The Employer reserves the right to reject any or all Tenders without assigning any reason or what so ever. Conditional tenders will not be accepted.

As per Karnataka State Government order No.LD/300/LET/2006 Bangalore Dated 01.01.2007 and Government Letter No.PW/134/BMS/2007 Dated 27-07-2007, a sum amounting to 1% of the bill amount will be deducted towards Construction Labour Welfare fund. Royalty on construction materials and other taxes will be deducted as per prevailing Govt., orders as may be modified from time to time

Work done certificate should be issued by competent authority not below the rank of Executive Engineer and Submitted Work done certificate should include E-PROCUREMENT INDENT NUMBER. The Tenderer shall scan Original Workdone certificates / Turnover Statements and any other documents specified by the employer and attach the scanned file to the Bid. The Original Documents shall be produced for physical verification within one week from the date of Technical bid opening or when called for during evaluation of tender

a) Financial turnover of previous years shall be given a weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the price level of the 2026-27. b) The Tenderer should maintain the Work during defective liability period i.e., TWO Year from the completion date. c) The Tenders are invited as per Standard tender Bid Document, All terms and conditions as per tender documents and Other details can be seen in the tender documents.
As per Government Order NO: FD 675 EXP 12./2020 Bangalore Dated 22-12-2020 action will be taken if the documents submitted by the tenderer found to be misleading /forged or fake

Bidders have to quote and execute the work as per the detailed specification given in Sanctioned estimate and the instructions of the Engineer incharge. The copy of the estimate can be obtained from the Asst. Executive Engineers office, DHUDA, Davanagere during Office hours

Certificate of registration in the labor Department / Provident Fund / ESI should be enclosed and shall engage a construction worker who is registered with the Karnataka Building and construction Workers Welfare Board
As per the Govt. Order No.DE 447 Exp-12/2022 Dated: 30-07-2022 GST will be added to the contract amount separately
The tenderer should be a PWD registered Contractor - Class-2 And above
Any discrepencies observed in the documents uploaded by the tenderer the tender will be rejected
Royalty on construction materials and other taxes will be deducted as per prevailing Govt orders as may be modified from time to time
Bidder has to quote excluding GST. GST will be paid seperately
The employer reserves the right to reject any or all tenders without assingning any reason whatsoever
The earnest money deposit will be forfeited if the documents submitted by the tenderer found to be misleading forged/fake
Only relevant documents should be submitted in KPP Portal
All terms & conditions as per bid document
